fiona: Before the Devils invaded, Fiona trained circus animals in eastern Erathia. Hell Hounds were always temperamental, but she quickly proved that her control over animals extended to them. Eeofol immediately accepted her into its armies.
ignatius: When the Devils came to Erathia, Ignatius believed joining them was his only chance to survive. He has persuaded them that he can still be useful, though he fears they may someday decide a human is no longer needed among them.
ash: Ash received her name during the first attack on Erathia. Her forces trapped several dozen Elves and Dwarves inside a wooden fort, then her spell blasted it so completely that the structure became a cloud of ash, exposing its very shocked occupants.
